about: 2026-10-11 pass 12: Vals AI's openly licensed papers. Vals AI (vals.ai) is an independent evaluator that runs its own tests; earlier briefs wrongly listed it as an aggregator. arXiv author search (Rayan Krishnan, Langston Nashold, Antoine Bigeard, Katrina Drozdov, Hung Tran, Nikil Ravi and co-authors; 'Vals AI' affiliation) and the arXiv links on vals.ai's benchmark pages find four Vals AI papers, all CC BY 4.0: Finance Agent Benchmark (2508.00828v1), Vibe Code Bench (2603.04601v1-v3), FormalProofBench (2603.26996v1, Vals' 'ProofBench') and Legal Research Bench (2610.00609v1, imported in pass 11). Each paper's main leaderboard table is imported as one new benchmark (the authors ran every model themselves). No numbers are taken from the vals.ai website (all rights reserved) or from the vals-ai GitHub repos; one harness README/source file at a pinned commit is cited only as identity evidence for model ids and reasoning settings.

benchmarks.name: Finance Agent Benchmark v1 (537 questions, class-balanced accuracy)
benchmarks.description: Finance Agent Benchmark as published in the paper (Vals AI, arXiv:2508.00828v1, CC BY 4.0): 537 expert-written financial-analyst research questions over recent SEC filings in nine task categories, answered by a tool-using agent (Google web search via SerpAPI, EDGAR full-text search, HTML page parsing, retrieval over stored pages). Rubric grading by an LLM judge. Score = class-balanced accuracy: accuracy per task category, averaged with equal weight. Not the later Finance Agent v1.1 or v2 leaderboards on vals.ai.

benchmarks.name: Vibe Code Bench (test split, 50 web apps)
benchmarks.description: Vibe Code Bench as published in the paper (Vals AI, arXiv:2603.04601v3, CC BY 4.0): build a complete, deployable web application (React + Vite, Supabase, Docker Compose; email and Stripe integrations where specified) from a natural-language specification inside an OpenHands-based sandbox with terminal, browser and web search, within 5 hours of wall-clock time. A Browser Use agent (Claude Sonnet 4.5) runs the app's pre-written user workflows; a workflow passes when at least 90% of its substeps succeed. Score = share of workflows passed per app, averaged over the 50 held-out test apps (473 workflows).

benchmarks.name: FormalProofBench (200 graduate-level Lean 4 problems, agentic)
benchmarks.description: FormalProofBench (Vals AI, arXiv:2603.26996v1, CC BY 4.0; Vals' 'ProofBench'): 200 private advanced-undergraduate and graduate problems from qualifying exams and textbooks (analysis, probability, functional analysis, number theory, logic, algebra, algebraic geometry), each given as a natural-language statement plus a Lean 4 formal statement. The model works as an agent with Mathlib search (Loogle), Lean code execution and a submit tool, up to 40 turns; a problem counts only if the submitted proof passes the Lean 4 kernel (Lean v4.25.2, Mathlib c98ae54; axiom and local_instance rejected). Score = share of the 200 problems solved, as printed in Table 2.

Search method: arXiv API author queries for Rayan Krishnan, Langston Nashold, Antoine Bigeard, Katrina Drozdov, Oliver Chen, Hung Tran, Nikil Ravi, Shirley Wu, Kexing Ying, Vasilii Nesterov, Elif Uskuplu, Bingyu Xia, Janitha Aswedige, Alex Gu, 'Jaff'; full-text 'Vals AI'/'vals.ai'; title queries (Vibe Code Bench, ProofBench, Finance Agent, CorpFin, CaseLaw, TaxEval, MedCode, MedScribe, SRE Bench, RSI Index); web searches; and the arXiv/GitHub/OpenReview links on 38 vals.ai benchmark pages (pages read only to find papers; no numbers taken). Only the four papers above are authored by Vals AI people.

No openly licensed paper found for Vals' CorpFin v2, CaseLaw v2, TaxEval v2, Tax Agent Bench, MortgageTax, MedCode, MedScribe, MedQA, SAGE, Excel Modelling Benchmark (EMB), SRE Bench, Vals RSI Index, Vals Index, Poker Agent, Public Benefits Bench, Mental Health, Mystery Mechanism, Code Migration, VCB-1-100, Voice Code Bench, Web Search, Finance Agent v1.1/v2, or the LegalBench page. These exist only as vals.ai pages ('Copyright © 2026 Vals AI. All rights reserved.'), so nothing is taken.

Not Vals-authored, so out of scope here: arXiv:2606.23032 IPO Finance Agent (Mostapha Benhenda; builds on Finance Agent v2); arXiv:2602.12670 SkillsBench (Vals hosts a leaderboard; no Vals authors); arXiv:2405.14358 (cited on the vals.ai cyber page); OpenReview xFrlcTacCE (cited on the vals.ai mental-health page).
